published.source: DPS report 2026-10-28 (full re-sim at 20,000 iterations, 180 s, after the launch-realm hunter hotfix)

verify.note: class worker sim of this request, 180s, seed 1

summary: The cat keeping Faerie Fire (Feral) on the boss for the raid. Its own attacks gain from the armor, so it only costs a few GCDs.
rotation: Opener: plain Cat Form (no Stealth/Prowl); a Night Elf's Shadowmeld in the fight opens Ravage
Racials, trinkets and potions on cooldown; Berserk with the on-use trinket, Elune's Light outside Berserk
Faerie Fire (Feral) from Cat Form first after the cooldowns, again once it has under 7s left, so a miss gets a retry (free, 1s GCD, 6s cooldown)
Shifting Power at 50 Energy or less, unless a Ferocious Bite is due (5 CP and Rip has 6s or more)
Ferocious Bite at any combo points in the last 2s
Rip at 5 combo points when it is down (not in the last 8s)
Ferocious Bite at 5 combo points and 35 Energy while Rip has 6s or more left (or in the last 8s)
Shadowmeld into Ravage from behind on Clearcasting, or in the last 10s with the Energy for it
Rake below 5 combo points when it is down (not in the last 6s)
caveats: Costs 5.5 / 4.5 / 1.7 DPS vs the base build at 120s / 180s / 300s.
Rip's level 31+ client ranks are 6-9% below Era. Era values would add 1.6%.
Idol of the Dream (Rip 2s longer) is 3.0 ahead of Howling Idol at 180s.
Clearcasting is fished for before the pull (standards 13), worth 4.6 to the Night Elf.
Unverified: Shred's flat bonus, AP on Rip and Ferocious Bite, Rend and Tear's scope
Rake's 5.5% attack power a tick is wowsims/forever's fit to testers' rank 1 ticks. Keeping Rake up is 38-42 ahead of no Rake.
One +2% crit elixir. Grizzly instead of Ferocity adds only its 25 Strength.
Tiger's Fury is gone in Forever.
Cat swing damage spreads 20% either side (the server's range is unknown).
Windfury Totem and a second shaman's Grace of Air in the melee group. Elemental Sharpening Stone is left out (Molten Core plans).
Feral Swiftness 2 (movement speed) is a must-take (standards 26), for Natural Shapeshifter's point: costs 0.0 / 0.0 / 3.5 DPS at 120s / 180s / 300s (shapeshift mana in long fights).
No explosive: EZ-Thro Dark Bomb's GCDs lose to the Faerie Fire casts here (1.6 / 0.6 / 0.0 behind none at 120s / 180s / 300s, standards 11).
notes: druid__feral-cat.json with the raid's Faerie Fire and Curse of Recklessness off (Forever's two share the minor armor slot, standards 20, so with the curse on the druid's own Faerie Fire adds nothing) and the level60_ff rotation. The base request's EZ-Thro Dark Bomb is removed too (it loses on the duty build, standards 11). Everything else is the base request.
